title: VMM-265 Marines reunite with families after deployment
credit: Video by U.S. Marine Corps Sgt. Edison Lobos
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron 265, Marine Aircraft Group 36, 1st Marine Aircraft Wing aboard MV-22B Ospreys return to Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, Okinawa, Japan, August 10, 2025. The Marines returned to their families after a two-month deployment on the USS America. (Video by U.S. Marine Corps Sgt. Edison Lobos)
